company: The text describes a commercial enterprise run for profit, for example a carmaker, retail chain, lender, airline, record label, biotech firm or software developer.
educational institution: The text describes a school, college, university, academy or similar establishment that exists mainly to teach students.
artist: The text describes an individual known chiefly for creative work or performance, for example a composer, guitarist, singer, painter, engraver, actor or novelist.
athlete: The text describes an individual known chiefly for playing or competing in a sport, such as a footballer, cyclist, swimmer or boxer.
office holder: The text describes an individual known chiefly for holding an official post, such as a politician, legislator, mayor, prosecutor, judge, diplomat or senior public official.
means of transport: The text describes a vehicle or a class of vehicle, such as a named ship, a locomotive class, an aircraft type or a car model.
building: The text describes one particular constructed building or tower, for example a house, church, courthouse, castle, hotel, prison, museum or skyscraper.
natural place: The text describes a landform or body of water, such as a mountain, hill, pass, volcano, river, creek, lake, reservoir, bay, cave or even a crater on another planet.
village: The text describes a village or hamlet, a small rural community, typically placing it within a district, county or province.
animal: The text describes an animal species or genus, such as a moth, snail, beetle, bird or fish, often giving its family or range.
plant: The text describes a plant species or genus, such as a tree, shrub, flowering herb, grass or fern, often giving its family or habitat.
album: The text describes a music release by a named performer, such as a studio or live album, an EP, a greatest-hits collection or a soundtrack.
film: The text describes a motion picture, whether feature, documentary, short or animated, often naming its director, cast or release year.
written work: The text describes a written publication, such as a novel, non-fiction book, poetry collection, magazine, newspaper, academic journal or comic series.
